services.name: Public Cycle Boat Charter
services.desc: This is a public cruise, so other guests can join you. The cruise will only run once it is booked for at least 8 passengers (this can all be from separate parties). This option is only for passengers 13 and older. Minimum of 2 tickets purchased per group.

services.name: Public Sunset Charter
services.desc: Public Sunset Charter. This is a public cruise, so other guests can join you. The cruise will only run once it is booked for at least 8 passengers (this can all be from separate parties). This option is only for passengers 16 and older.

services.name: Private Cycle Boat Charter
services.desc: Book Queen City Cycle Boat Privately! This experience includes a base price for up to 16 guests, each additional guest (up to 24 total) will have a per ticket cost of $35 per person. Don't know how many guests yet? Book for 16 & add the rest of the crew later! This experience is for guests 8 and older.
